propositions: A dedicated executor client must be constructed with max_retries=0 via jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0) and reject any session with nonzero max_retries.

Each DC summary write invocation must execute exactly GET-PUT-GET without hidden repeats, classifying pre-mutation GET faults as retryable/permanent and PUT faults as ambiguous (commit_unknown, request_count=2).
A successful PUT followed by read-back GET is marked applied (request_count=3) only when the observed summary equals the intended new summary; otherwise commit_unknown (request_count=3).

After an ambiguous PUT, a separate single-attempt GET observation is mapped via decide_replay: observed summary matching intended value returns recovered (no further write); mismatch permits remaining-budget replay; GET failure returns non-replaying commit_unknown.

Every DC terminal/exhausted outcome or cleanup failure must emit exactly one redacted completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one message capped at 512 Unicode code points, with total log at most 1,024 Unicode code points.
